name: not-a-budget
description: NAB (Not A Budget): quarterly cash-flow tracking against a flat spend curve, external-fund credits, and CSV import/normalization over a SQLite database.
long_description: Tracks spending against a flat linear quarterly curve (default $15,000/quarter) rather than a traditional category budget. Supports an external-fund credit system where large one-off purchases funded from savings are subtracted from net spend, a guided import flow that normalizes and de-duplicates arbitrary transaction CSVs, and canonical 'spend vs budget' and quarter-comparison views whose results carry explicit render instructions.

tools.name: set_config
tools.description: Update a budget's quarterly_goal, curve_days, or budget_name.

tools.name: import_file
tools.description: Bulk-import a normalized CSV/JSON file by path; preferred for many rows. Dedups and filters payments/transfers.

tools.name: import_transactions
tools.description: Import pre-normalized transaction rows (array or rows_json string); dedups and filters out payments/transfers.

tools.name: add_credit
tools.description: Add an external-fund credit that offsets net spend on its date.

tools.name: mark_credit_transferred
tools.description: Mark an external-fund credit as transferred (or not).

tools.name: get_budget_info
tools.description: Read-only: return a budget's path and configuration.

tools.name: list_budgets
tools.description: Read-only: list budget files found in the configured budgets folder.

tools.name: list_transactions
tools.description: Read-only: list transactions, optionally filtered by quarter or date range.

tools.name: list_credits
tools.description: Read-only: list external-fund credits, optionally filtered by quarter.

tools.name: quarter_status
tools.description: Read-only: cumulative net spend vs the flat budget curve for a quarter (the headline view).

tools.name: year_summary
tools.description: Read-only: quarter-over-quarter net spend vs goal comparison.

tools.name: category_breakdown
tools.description: Read-only: per-category spend for a quarter (analysis only).

tools.name: get_cli_info
tools.description: Read-only: return the binary path and CLI usage for script-based bulk import/query.
